title: Publish Decapod v0.99.0 with registry-backed Dactyl v0.8.2
intent: Fix PR #1265 so Decapod v0.99.0 publishes dactyl-db v0.8.2 from crates.io with sqlite and neon features, Nix vendoring succeeds on Ubuntu and macOS, and all governance and living-spec proof artifacts are current.
stop_conditions: Do not change the Decapod package version from 0.99.0.
Do not claim Nix hosted proof until GitHub CI runs.

forbidden_paths: Do not mutate .decapod state directly; use Decapod CLI.
